n = int(input())
m = int(input())
P = int(input())

def add_mod(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= P:
        a -= P
    return a

def multiply(a, b):
    return (a * b) % P

def multiply_self(a, b):
    a[0] = (a[0] * b) % P

MAX = 511
dwu = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
dp1 = [0] * (MAX)
dp2 = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
dp3 = [[0] * (MAX) for _ in range(MAX)]
count = [0] * (MAX)

# Precompute binomial coefficients
for i in range(n + 1):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        if j == 0:
            dwu[i][j] = 1
        else:
            dwu[i][j] = add_mod(dwu[i - 1][j], dwu[i - 1][j - 1])

dp1[0] = 0
count[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(i):
        temp = 0
        temp = add_mod(temp, multiply(dp1[j], count[i - j - 1]))
        temp = add_mod(temp, multiply(dp1[i - j - 1], count[j]))
        temp = multiply(temp, j + 1)
        temp2 = multiply(multiply(count[i - j - 1], count[j]), j * (j + 1) // 2)
        temp = add_mod(temp, temp2)
        temp = multiply(temp, dwu[i - 1][j])
        dp1[i] = add_mod(dp1[i], temp)

        temp = dwu[i - 1][j]
        temp = multiply(temp, count[j])
        temp = multiply(temp, count[i - j - 1])
        temp = multiply(temp, j + 1)
        count[i] = add_mod(count[i], temp)
    count[i] = add_mod(count[i], count[i])
    dp1[i] = add_mod(dp1[i], dp1[i])

# Initialize DP tables
for i in range(n + 2):
    for j in range(m + 1):
        for k in range(m + 1):
            if j + k <= m and i + k + 1 <= n + 1:
                temp = dp2[i][j]
                temp = multiply(temp, dwu[m - j][k])
                temp = multiply(temp, count[k])
                temp3 = dp3[i][j]
                temp3 = multiply(temp3, count[k])
                temp3 = add_mod(temp3, multiply(dp1[k], dp2[i][j]))
                temp3 = multiply(temp3, dwu[m - j][k])
                dp3[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(dp3[i + k + 1][j + k], temp3)
                dp2[i + k + 1][j + k] = add_mod(dp2[i + k + 1][j + k], temp)

print(dp3[n + 1][m])
